Note 1 (all-weather driving surface): exact match. findings.reasoning: The validation methodology requires ~90% semantic match for AF-01 notes. Evaluating each note: Notes 1,3,4,7 are 100% matches (4 notes). Note 5 is ~20% match (wrong subject - talks about combustible construction instead of commercial dumpsters). Overall semantic match: (100+70+100+100+20+90+100)/7 = 83%, which falls below the required 90% threshold. Notes 2 and 5 have substantive semantic differences from the required text.

See the CoA standard notes template for the expected notes.
